article.articleHeadline: Statewide free FMD vaccination drive for cattle and buffaloes begins
article.articleSummary: Andhra Pradesh launches statewide free vaccination drive against Foot-and-Mouth Disease for cattle and buffaloes, including calves over four months, under the National Animal Disease Control Programme. Campaign runs March 16–April 29, 2026, in two phases: main round March 16–April 14 and second phase April 15–29, with vaccines administered at owners' homes free of charge. State has supplied 83.69 lakh vaccine doses to districts for the campaign. FMD is a highly contagious viral disease affecting cattle and buffaloes; cross-bred animals are more vulnerable. Vaccination is described as the only effective preventive measure. Transmission occurs via wounds, contaminated fodder, feed, water, dung, and urine of infected animals. Symptoms include fever 104-106°F, mouth and lip blisters, excessive salivation, hoof and udder blisters causing lameness. Calves may die after consuming milk; pregnant animals may abort; recovery can take up to six months. Economic losses loom due to milk decline and reduced work capacity.

triage.headline_ja: 州全体で牛と水牛に対する無料FMD予防接種キャンペーンが開始
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫は家畜感染症として経済的影響が大きく異常/予想外の基準に該当する可能性があるが、本記事は予防接種キャンペーンの開始を報じるもので、アウトブレイク報告ではなく、人間への感染リスクがないため国際拡大の懸念は低い。情報不足により経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は動物感染症（家畜向けワクチンキャンペーン）であり、人間への直接的な公衆衛生上の脅威ではない。口蹄疫は人間には感染しない。IHRスクリーニングの対象外である可能性が高いが、経済的被害の可能性と流行のしやすさから、家畜疾病サーベイランスの観点では注視対象。アウトブレイク報告ではなく予防接種キャンペーンニュースであるため、シグナル化の必要性は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Dinas Peternakan Belu Pastikan Kucing yang Gigit 11 Warga Manumutin Positif Rabies - Pos-kupang.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Belu Department of Animal Husbandry confirms rabies-positive cat that bit 11 residents of Manumutin
article.articleSummary: Rabies confirmed in Belu Regency, East Nusa Tenggara, Indonesia, after a cat that bit 11 residents in Manumutin, Atambua City District. Brain examination at a veterinary laboratory confirmed rabies, following a rapid test by a veterinary health doctor. The cat has been captured; authorities are coordinating with BPBD Belu and local officials to curb spread. On 16 March 2026, a Dinas Peternakan dan Perikanan working group will conduct a sweep for unvaccinated rabies reservoir animals (cats and dogs) and carry out comprehensive vaccination. Of the 11 bitten, nine have received post-exposure vaccination at a Puskesmas; two with hypertension have not yet been vaccinated. Rabies vaccine stock remains around 18,000 doses; a third round of vaccination is planned for May 2026. Residents are urged to report aggressive dogs or cats and vaccinate pets.

triage.headline_ja: ベル県家畜局、ムムティン地区で11人を咬んだ猫の狂犬病陽性を確認
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病確認事例で複数の住民が露出（11人中9人が既に曝露後予防接種を受けているが2人未接種）、公衆衛生への深刻な影響あり。異常性と国際的拡大リスクを考慮するとIHR基準2つ以上該当の可能性が高く、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は公衆衛生上の重大疾患（ほぼ100%致死率）。インドネシア・東ヌサテンガラ州での確認、11人の住民接触、未接種者2名の存在、貯蔵ワクチン18,000用量という供給状況から総合評価するとシグナルとして認識が妥当。今後の症例発生およびワクチン不足リスクを注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: 广东男子喝"生猪血"，半年后肢体抽搐、口吐白沫，失去意识...竟是寄生虫在头部安家！_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Guangdong man drinks "raw pig blood," six months later experiences limb convulsions, foaming at the mouth, and loses consciousness... it turns out a parasite has taken up residence in his head!
article.articleSummary: A Guangdong man from Shanwei drank raw pig blood and, six months later, developed seizures, foaming at the mouth, and loss of consciousness. Brain MRI initially raised concern for a tumor, but after excluding neoplasms and vascular disease and considering dietary exposure, doctors diagnosed cerebral neurocysticercosis caused by Taenia solium cysticerci entering the central nervous system via bloodstream. The patient, in his 30s and who had worked in Zhejiang, underwent workup in Guangzhou and Guangzhou before treatment in Hangzhou. At Shulan Hospital (Hangzhou) Infectious Diseases Department, led by Dr. Gao Haina, his right frontal lobe lesion and intracranial edema progressively shrank with targeted therapy over six months, with symptoms resolving. A follow-up in March 2026 confirmed improvement. He was advised to avoid raw pig blood, highlighting the infection risk from undercooked pork products and the lack of an outbreak-like situation.

triage.headline_ja: 広東省の男性が「生豚血」を飲食、半年後に肢体けいれん・口吐白沫・意識喪失...頭部に寄生虫が寄生していた！
triage.triage_reason: 脳神経嚢虫症（neurocysticercosis）の散発症例報告で、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は明確でなく、国際的拡大リスクも低いと判断されるが、食品由来感染症の教訓と複数地域での患者報告のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 嚢虫症は散発症例であり、記事では「アウトブレイク様の状況がない」と明記されている。個別症例の臨床報告であるが、生肉・生血摂取に関連した食品由来感染症として公衆衛生的な注意喚起情報として一定の価値がある。複数地域（広東省、浙江省）での患者報告だが、因果関係は一患者の行動に限定されているため、システミックな伝播リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Mutirão intersetorial de combate à dengue já alcança mais de 13 mil moradores em Cuiabá
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Intersectoral mobilization to combat dengue has already reached over 13,000 residents in Cuiabá.
article.articleSummary: Intersectoral mobilization in Cuiabá, Brazil, targets Aedes aegypti breeding sites to prevent dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. The city’s SMS-led task force plans to cover 53 neighborhoods and about 83,836 properties, with ~285 Endemic Disease Control Agents and support from Community Health Agents. Initiated on February 24, 2026, and running through May 5, 2026 (39 days), the campaign operates four days per week, weather permitting. To date, eight neighborhoods have been served, reaching ~13,237 residents with guidance, property inspections, and removal of standing-water sources. Early areas: Planalto, Novo Terceiro, Coophamil, 1º de Março, Parque Atalaia, Bela Vista, Cidade Alta, José Pinto. The “Ação Única” strategy combines ACEs and ACSs in a single visit to address all sanitation needs. Remaining neighborhoods include Três Barras, Jardim Liberdade, Novo Colorado, among others. After neighborhood completion, Primary Health assumes ongoing family and property monitoring to prevent reintroduction; public participation is essential.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱撲滅のための部門横断的動員がクイアバで既に13,000人以上の住民に到達
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア熱の予防的な蚊対策キャンペーンの進捗報告であり、新規の感染症発生イベントではない。既知の地域的課題への対応活動の記録であることから、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判断。
triage.notes: 本記事はBluedot検出イベントであるが、内容は既存の地域的蚊媒介感染症対策の組織的キャンペーン報告である。新規の感染症危機シグナルではなく、ブラジル当局による予防的介入の実行状況の記録と評価される。

article.articleHeadline: Kinshasa : amélioration de la situation du choléra à la prison de Makala, 187 guérisons enregistrées
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kinshasa: Improvement in the cholera situation at Makala Prison, 187 recoveries recorded
article.articleSummary: Cholera remains active in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of Congo, but conditions are improving after authorities’ measures. In Kinshasa province, about 240 new suspected cholera cases and deaths were reported; 84 active patients are treated in cholera centers, up from 41 a week earlier. At Makala Central Prison, six active cholera cases are hospitalized; total recoveries reach 187 and five deaths have been recorded since Feb 12, 2026. The INRB confirmed 13 positive cases from 17 samples; among confirmed, four recovered and five deaths. Fifteen new suspected cases were identified on Feb 13, 2026. A Feb 14 circular by Justice Minister Guillaume Ngefa Atondoko Andali bans new admissions to Makala, tightens visits, and orders strengthened sanitation, medicines, disinfection, and daily epidemiological reporting in coordination with the Health Ministry. Mpox: in week 9, suspected cases rose from 258 to 285; since 2024, 123,762 suspected and 34,822 confirmed.

triage.headline_ja: キンシャサ：マカラ刑務所のコレラ状況の改善、187人の回復を記録
triage.triage_reason: コレラとMpoxの両疾患が同時に報告され、IHR基準4項目中3項目以上に該当。コレラは刑務所という限定環境での集団発生で制御が困難、Mpoxは2024年以来12万件以上の疑い症例を記録し国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国キンシャサでコレラとMpoxが同時進行中。コレラは刑務所内での集団発生（2/12以降計192人確認、5死亡）で、当局が新規収容禁止・面会制限・衛生強化等の対策を実施。Mpox例数は週間258→285件に増加、累計12万件超。両疾患ともWHO通知基準を満たし、特にMpoxは地域的な流行制御状況が不透明なため要注視。

article.articleHeadline: Cuiabá registra mais de 300 notificações de dengue; veja como evitar o mosquito
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cuiabá records more than 300 dengue notifications; see how to prevent the dengue-carrying mosquito.
article.articleSummary: In early 2026, Cuiabá recorded 323 dengue notifications with 139 confirmed, a 79.2% decrease from the same period in 2025. Chikungunya showed 59 notifications with 58 confirmed, down 99.3% in Q1, while Zika had 4 notifications with no confirmed cases. The reductions follow intensified Aedes aegypti control efforts across the city. From January to March 2026, 197,192 properties were inspected by Endemic Combat Agents; 21,672 required direct treatment, 24,344 water-containing deposits were treated, and 6,559 mosquito breeding sites were eliminated. Prevention guidance emphasizes removing standing water from containers, sealing water tanks, cleaning gutters and drains, using repellents as directed, and allowing endemic-control agents access for inspections. The measures target multiple Cuiabá neighborhoods to curb transmission of dengue, chikungunya, and Zika.

triage.headline_ja: クイアバ市でデング熱の通知が300件以上を記録; 蚊を予防する方法をご覧ください
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのクイアバ市でデング熱、チクングニア、ジカウイルスの通知が記録されているが、前年同期比で79.2%～99.3%の著しい減少を示しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響は限定的。蚊対策の強化により状況は改善傾向にある。
triage.notes: 複数の蚊媒介ウイルス（デング熱、チクングニア、ジカ）の同時発生が報告されているものの、前年同期比での大幅な減少が示されており、公衆衛生危機ではなく改善状況の報告と見なされる。ブラジル国内の地方レベルのニュースであり、国際的な拡大リスクや支援の必要性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo: São Paulo registra 1º caso em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles: São Paulo records its first case in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Measles in São Paulo marks Brazil's first case in 2026. A 6-month-old girl, unvaccinated and resident of São Paulo, contracted measles after exposure linked to Bolivia, where an outbreak has been ongoing since 2025. The child traveled to Bolivia from 25 December 2025 to 25 January 2026; the case is considered imported. Laboratory confirmation occurred in early March 2026 by the São Paulo municipality after genomic sequencing, with the Ministry of Health noting the import origin. This is the first confirmed measles case in the State of São Paulo in 2026; São Paulo state had two imported cases in 2025. Nationwide, Brazil reported 38 confirmed cases in 2025 (Tocantins 25; Mato Grosso 6; Rio de Janeiro 2; São Paulo 2; Distrito Federal 1; Rio Grande do Sul 1; Maranhão 1). Bolivia has an ongoing outbreak near Brazil’s borders with Mato Grosso do Sul and Tocantins. Measles is highly contagious; vaccination is crucial; symptoms include fever, red rash, cough, conjunctivitis; complications include pneumonia, encephalitis, dehydration; transmission is airborne.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹：サンパウロが2026年初の症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおける麻疹の輸入症例報告であり、ボリビアの国境地域での継続的な流行に関連している。IHR基準では異常性・予想外性と国際的拡大リスクが該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性、流行しやすさ、管理可能性が認められる。フルRRAへの進行が必要。
triage.notes: ボリビアでの2025年以来の継続的な流行、ブラジル-ボリビア国境地域での複数州への拡大（Tocantins、Mato Grosso do Sul境界）、高い伝染性、予防接種率の重要性など、地域的な懸念事項が明確。輸入症例による二次感染リスクが存在。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Campak Melonjak di Awal 2026, Pemerintah Percepat Imunisasi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles cases surge at the start of 2026, government accelerates immunization.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases surged at the start of 2026, with 45 outbreaks reported across 29 districts/cities in 11 provinces as of week 8. Week 7 recorded 9,947 suspected cases and 7,922 confirmed cases with 5 deaths; week 8 rose to 10,453 suspected and 8,372 confirmed cases, with 6 deaths. In response, the Ministry of Health accelerated immunization, targeting 102 districts/cities for outbreak response immunization aimed at children aged 9–59 months. The program concentrates on outbreak-affected areas through Outbreak Response Immunization and on high-risk regions via a Catch-Up Campaign to immunize those not yet reached. The surge signals ongoing measles transmission early in 2026, prompting intensified vaccination to curb spread across the affected provinces. Keywords: vaccination, outbreak response, catch-up campaign, measles, public health.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年初頭のはしかケースが急増、政府が予防接種を加速
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで45件の集団発生が報告され、確認症例が1週間で8,000件以上、死亡者も複数出ており、複数州にまたがる地理的拡大を示している。IHR基準3つ以上該当し、WPRO基準でも重症度と流行しやすさが明確。
triage.notes: 2026年初頭での急速な増加傾向（週7から週8で感染疑い者が500例以上増加）、複数州での地理的拡散（11州29地区）、死亡者の報告、政府による緊急対応の実施など、シグナルとしての条件を満たしている。フルRRA進行推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Nova linhagem do vírus Oropouche é identificada no Sudeste - Brazil Urgente
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New lineage of the Oropouche virus identified in Southeast Brazil - Urgent.
article.articleSummary: New reassortant lineage of Oropouche virus circulating in Southeast Brazil, with 55 confirmed infections in Rio de Janeiro and Minas Gerais from December 2024 to May 2025. Researchers from Universidade Federal Fluminense analyzed 55 confirmed cases; genetic sequencing identifies a reassortant lineage, indicating genome segment reorganization and adaptation to the Southeast, suggesting potential longer-term establishment with variable circulation. Findings published January 7 in Open Forum Infectious Diseases. Clinically, most patients reported severe headaches and malaise (87%), along with fever, myalgia, and skin rashes. This expands the virus’s geographic range beyond its historic Amazon region association. No deaths reported in the study; authors warn of ongoing regional circulation and possible shifts in epidemiology.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル南東部で新系統のオロポウシェウイルスが確認される
triage.triage_reason: 新規の再配合系統であり、地理的分布の拡大（アマゾン地域から南東部への拡大）、持続的な地域循環の可能性、および国際的な拡大リスクがある。IHR基準3つ該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、地域への影響）、WPRO基準4つ該当（異常性、地理的拡大、流行性、管理課題）。
triage.notes: オロポウシェウイルスの新規再配合系統がブラジル南東部（リオデジャネイロ・ミナスジェライス州）で55例確認。従来はアマゾン地域に限定されていたが、南東部への地理的拡大は異常。遺伝子配列解析により系統的な適応と持続循環の可能性を示唆。患者の87%が重篤な頭痛と全身倦怠感を報告。死亡例なし。南米を超えた国際的な拡大可能性とカリブ海地域への波及リスクに留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de hepatite A aumentam em Ribeirão Preto, SP, e colocam Saúde em alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases of Hepatitis A are rising in Ribeirão Preto, São Paulo, and health authorities are on alert.
article.articleSummary: Hepatitis A cases rise in Ribeirão Preto, São Paulo, Brazil, prompting a health alert. From January through March 2026, the city recorded 203 Hepatitis A cases, compared with only 2 in the same period of 2025. Officials say the increase began in December and has persisted, described as a surge beyond what is expected but not exponential. Transmission occurs via contaminated water, food or objects, and through close contact or sharing utensils; sexual transmission with fecal-oral exposure is possible. No single contamination point has been identified; authorities investigate case-by-case and coordinate with healthcare networks to provide laboratory diagnostics. Symptoms typically begin with fatigue, fever and nausea, followed by gastrointestinal symptoms; darker urine and jaundice can appear in advanced stages. Vaccination against Hepatitis A is available through the SUS in all city vaccination sites and is advised for children and at-risk groups. Prevention emphasizes hygiene and vaccination; avoid alcohol during treatment.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル・リベイラン・プレット州のA型肝炎患者が急増し、保健当局が警戒態勢へ
triage.triage_reason: 2026年1月～3月で203例の急増（前年同期は2例）と異常性が明確であり、WPROスクリーニング基準で異常/予想外、重症度、流行しやすさの3つに該当。IHR基準も複数該当する可能性が高い。
triage.notes: 103倍の患者数増加（2例→203例）という顕著な異常性が確認されている。汚染源が特定されておらず、継続的な曝露リスクがある。A型肝炎はワクチン予防可能だが、流行地域での制御難度は高い。記事日付が2026年3月と未来日付であるため、データ検証が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de Síndrome Respiratória Aguda Grave (SRAG) voltam a aumentar no país - O Alto Acre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases of Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARS) on the rise again in the country - O Alto Acre.
article.articleSummary: Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) cases are rising across Brazil, per Fiocruz InfoGripe. In Epidemiological Week 8 (Feb 22–28), increases occurred in 23 states and the Federal District; Roraima, Tocantins, Espírito Santo and Rio Grande do Sul did not rise. Hospitalizations have grown, with a notable rise among children and adolescents—linked to the return to school. Parents are advised to keep symptomatic kids at home or, if needed, have them wear masks in class. Ten states report SRAG at alert/risk/high risk; 12 of 27 capitals show activity with a long-term growth trend. In 2026, over 14,300 SRAG cases were notified, with 35% lab-confirmed for a respiratory virus; rhinovirus is most detected, followed by influenza A and SARS-CoV-2. COVID-19 accounts for most deaths, then influenza A and rhinovirus. Incidence remains higher in young children, while mortality is highest among the elderly.

triage.headline_ja: 呼吸器合胞体感染症(SRAG)の患者数がブラジル国内で再び増加
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル全域での複数呼吸器疾患(COVID-19、インフルエンザA)の同時増加、23州での増加報告、重症化傾向、小児・思春期での増加が確認され、IHR基準2つ以上(重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性)、WPRO基準複数該当(重症度、流行しやすさ)、および国内医療当局の関心が認められる。
triage.notes: 複数呼吸器疾患の同時増加、特にCOVID-19とインフルエンザAが検出されている。Fiocruzの公式監視データ(InfoGripe)に基づく報告で、信頼性が高い。小児層での顕著な増加と学校再開との関連が指摘されており、地域における流行拡大のリスクが存在。国際的な拡大可能性については記事に明記されていないが、ブラジルの大きな人口規模と国際的な移動を考慮するとモニタリング継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор направил запрос в Таиланд из-за вспышки инфекции на Пхукете
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor sent a request to Thailand due to an outbreak of infection in Phuket.
article.articleSummary: Rospotrebnadzor responded to media reports of a mass illness among Russian tourists in a Phuket hotel by sending formal data requests to Thailand’s Ministry of Health and to the Russian travel association ATOR, under a sanitary-epidemiological cooperation memorandum, to obtain official investigation results and a risk assessment of potential worsening of the outbreak. The agency’s press service said the situation is under control. Telegram channel Baza previously reported that 13 Russians were affected with gastroenteritis and conjunctivitis at the Thai resort, with tourists stating they drank tap water that was muddy and had a foul odor. Affected location is Phuket, Thailand; the implicated conditions are intestinal infection (gastroenteritis) and conjunctivitis. No official case counts beyond the reported 13 are confirmed in the article; the exchange underscores cross-border public health cooperation. Published date: 2026-03-15.

triage.headline_ja: ロスポトレブナゾル、フーケットの感染症流行によりタイに照会を送付
triage.triage_reason: 未確認疾患による集団発症で異常性が高いが、患者数が限定的（報告13名）であり、公式な発症数確認がなく、情報が不足している。WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目で該当の可能性がありながら、詳細な疫学情報の不足から経過観察段階と判定。
triage.notes: 原因不明の集団発症（胃腸炎と結膜炎）がフーケットのホテルで報告され、ロシア人観光客13名が影響を受けた。汚濁した水道水が感染源の可能性とされている。ロシア保健監視機関（Rospotrebnadzor）がタイ保健省に正式な照会を送付しており、国際的な公衆衛生協力が進行中。ただし、公式な患者数確認がなく、重症度、長期曝露リスク、旅行制限リスクについて詳細情報が不足している。複数国観光地での発症であることから国際的影響の可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Inverno amazônico eleva mortes por SRAG no Acre; estado já registra 16 óbitos em 2026 - O Alto Acre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amazonian winter increases SARS deaths in Acre; the state already records 16 deaths in 2026 - O Alto Acre
article.articleSummary: In Acre, Brazil, 16 deaths from severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) were reported in the first weeks of 2026, signaling a worrisome “Amazonian winter.” Most fatalities had comorbidities or were in high-risk groups (elderly, young children). The surge coincides with heavy rains that favor circulation of respiratory viruses, notably Influenza A and Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV). In February, Feijó municipality recorded two SARI deaths—a 59-year-old woman and a 6-year-old Indigenous child—linked to influenza A and rhinovirus. Fiocruz’s InfoGripe notes Acre among Northern states with SARI at elevated risk; nationally, rhinovirus accounts for 36.5% of positives, followed by SARS-CoV-2 20.4% and Influenza A 18.9%. Authorities emphasize continuous monitoring and clinical readiness; pregnant women vaccination is highlighted as a strategy to protect newborns against RSV. The situation remains under health surveillance as the season progresses.

triage.headline_ja: アマゾン冬季がアクレ州のSARI死亡を増加させる。州は2026年に既に16人の死亡を記録している
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザAおよびRSV感染による重症呼吸器感染症（SARI）が16人の死亡を記録し、重症度基準を満たす。また季節的パターン（アマゾン冬季）に関連した予期しない死亡増加であり、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: ブラジル・アクレ州でインフルエンザAおよびRSVによるSARI患者16人の死亡報告。高リスク集団（高齢者、幼児、先住民の子ども）に集中。重雨などの環境要因が呼吸器ウイルスの循環を促進している季節的状況。国家的な監視体制および予防戦略（妊婦ワクチン接種など）が実施中。ブラジル北部でのSARI上昇リスク警告あり。国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクについては現在の情報では判断困難だが、地域的な感染危機が進行中と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Investigadores advierten sobre hongo que pasa de gatos a personas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Researchers warn about a fungus that passes from cats to humans
article.articleSummary: First identified in Uruguay, Sporothrix brasiliensis, a fungus causing sporotrichosis, now poses a cat-to-human transmission risk with alerts for potential epidemics. The finding arose from a 2025 intrafamilial outbreak affecting people and their pets; initial link to a Brazilian street cat was later disproven as cases appeared in other areas. Dr. Elisa Cabeza notes the discovery confirms fungal circulation in Uruguay and supports strengthened surveillance, especially for vulnerable populations such as children under two and older adults. Sporotrichosis transmits from infected cats to humans when the fungus enters the skin via scratches, bites, or contact with wounds or secretions. Symptoms typically appear days to weeks after exposure: a small skin lesion at the injury site, followed by nodules along lymphatic pathways, with inflammation or redness. If diagnosed early, antifungal treatment is effective; veterinarians advise owners to inspect cats’ muzzles and ears for wounds or discharge.

triage.headline_ja: 研究者らが猫から人間に感染するキノコについて警告
triage.triage_reason: スポロトリコーシスの新興株（Sporothrix brasiliensis）がウルグアイで初めて同定され、猫からヒトへの感染リスクが確認された。複数国での流行の可能性と脆弱集団への影響が指摘されており、IHR基準2つ以上該当。
triage.notes: ウルグアイとブラジルの両国で確認された動物由来感染症（zoonosis）。2025年の家族内集団発生から2026年の警告発令まで時系列が明確。脆弱集団（2歳未満の小児、高齢者）への注視が必要。動物衛生当局との連携が重要。

article.articleHeadline: ¿Cómo es el hongo que gatos pueden transmitir a humanos?; especialistas activan alertas en Sudamérica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is the fungus that cats can transmit to humans? Specialists issue alerts in South America.
article.articleSummary: Sporotrichosis, a fungal infection primarily affecting the skin and subcutaneous tissue, is spreading from cats in South America. In late February, the Instituto de Higiene issued a population warning as surveillance in the Southern Cone intensified; Argentina also reports rising cases. The World Health Organization notes this Sporothrix fungus causes zoonotic infections transmitted via cats, with more than 11,000 human cases reported in the affected areas of South America over the past decade, mainly in Brazil. Transmission can also occur from other mammals or through contaminated materials or vegetation. Most infections are cutaneous, but rare cases can involve meningitis, arthritis, or respiratory infections. The alerts reflect regional monitoring changes and cross-border risk, with outbreaks linked to wood, mining materials, or flood-affected environments.

triage.headline_ja: ネコが人間に感染させることができるキノコとは？南米の専門家が警報を発動
triage.triage_reason: スポロトリコーシスは南米（ブラジル、アルゼンチン）で多数の人間感染例（過去10年間に11,000件以上）が報告されており、動物からのヒト感染が確認されている新興感染症。国際的拡大リスクと複数地域での同時検出により、IHR基準2つ以上に該当し、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 過去10年間に南米で11,000件以上の人間感染が報告されており、既に相当規模の流行状況。ブラジルとアルゼンチンの複数国での同時警告発出が確認される。人獣共通感染症（ネコからのヒト感染）、水災害や採鉱地域への関連性、稀に髄膜炎や呼吸器感染などの重篤例も存在。WHOによる言及あり。

article.articleHeadline: Folha da Região: Araçatuba intensifica combate à dengue com nebulização veicular
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Folha da Região: Araçatuba intensifies the fight against dengue with vehicular fogging.
article.articleSummary: Araçatuba, Brazil, launches a new phase of dengue vector control focused on Aedes aegypti, which transmits dengue, chikungunya, and Zika. Starting Monday, March 16, through Wednesday, March 18, operations run from 6:30 PM in the neighborhoods of São Vicente, Novo Paraíso, Paraíso, and Jardim Brasil. A vehicle-mounted fogging system (Nebulização Acoplada a Veículo, NAV) disperses insecticide to target adult mosquitoes in street and residential areas. The initiative follows intensified house-to-house visits by municipal health agents and the removal of potential breeding containers, with reinforced resident guidance on preventive measures. The effort is conducted with the support of the Coordinadoria de Controle de Doenças, under the Secretaria de Estado da Saúde. The article does not provide case counts or laboratory confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: Folha da Região: アラカツバ市、車両に搭載した噴霧による蚊媒介感染症対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・アラカツバ市でのデング熱を含む3疾患（デング、チクングニア、ジカ）の媒介蚊対策が実施されているが、患者数や感染確認例の報告がなく、公衆衛生への具体的な影響度が不明。今後の流行拡大について注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は蚊媒介感染症（デング、チクングニア、ジカ）の対策活動の報告であり、患者数や確認症例が記載されていない。行政による積極的な媒介蚊対策が実施されている点から、地域内での感染圧がある可能性が高い。ブラジルは蚊媒介感染症の常在地であり、これは通常の季節対応と考えられる。より詳細な疫学データ（患者数、発症率、確認例など）の入手により判定が変わる可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Preocupa expansión de fiebre amarilla fuera de la Amazonía, advierte la OPS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: PAHO warns of the expansion of yellow fever outside the Amazon.
article.articleSummary: As of March 15, 2026, PAHO warns of expanded yellow fever transmission across South America, including regions outside the Amazon Basin. Since September 2024, transmissions have appeared in areas previously unreported. In 2025, 346 confirmed yellow fever cases and 143 deaths occurred across seven South American countries. In the first seven weeks of 2026, 34 human cases and 15 deaths were recorded in Bolivia, Colombia, Peru, and Venezuela. PAHO urges member states to strengthen epidemiological surveillance, intensify vaccination campaigns for at-risk populations, and reinforce preventive measures for travelers to areas where yellow fever vaccination is recommended. The notice highlights a shifting epidemiology requiring sustained vaccination coverage and vigilance to curb further spread. Keywords: vaccination, outbreak, public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: PAHOが南米でのアマゾン外での黄熱病拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: 黄熱病の地理的拡大と多国間での継続的な人的感染が報告されており、IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常な地理的拡大、国際拡大リスク）に該当。WPRO基準複数項目該当し、国際的な関心も高い。
triage.notes: 2025年に346確定症例・143死亡、2026年初7週で34症例・15死亡とペースが加速。ペルー、ブラジル、ボリビア、ベネズエラ、コロンビアの5ヶ国に拡大。従来のアマゾン盆地外での発生報告は疫学的に重要なシグナル。PAHOからの公式警告により国際的関心も高い。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Over 15,900 Pet Cat Bite Cases Reported at SMHS in a Year - Kashmir Observer
article.articleSummary: Over one year (March 2025–March 2026), Shri Maharaja Hari Singh (SMHS) Hospital’s Anti-Rabies Clinic in Srinagar logged more than 15,900 pet cat bite cases from across Srinagar and other districts of the Kashmir Valley. The figure signals a steady demand for anti-rabies vaccination and post-bite care after domesticated cat bites or scratches. Medical staff note many patients seek care after seemingly minor injuries, but timely treatment is essential to prevent infections and rabies, which remains fatal once symptoms appear. Health guidance emphasizes washing wounds with soap and water immediately and seeking medical attention for post-exposure prophylaxis. Officials urge regular vaccination of pets and basic precautions in handling animals at home. The Anti-Rabies Clinic continues to vaccinate and treat hundreds of patients weekly, with cases from both urban and rural areas of the Kashmir Valley.

triage.headline_ja: Over 15,900 Pet Cat Bite Cases Reported at SMHS in a Year - Kashmir Observer
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の既知リスクに関する流行性疾患報告だが、ペット猫による咬傷件数の増加が主体。死亡や重症例の記載がなく、国際的拡大リスクも明記されていない。情報不足のため継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 1年間で15,900件のペット猫咬傷が報告され、継続的な曝露と流行性リスク（狂犬病）が認識されている。しかし、死亡例や重症例の記載がなく、重症度が不明確。カシミール地域内での地域的課題として当局の対応が進行中と見られる。続報にて死亡例・重症例の有無、ワクチン接種率、野生動物からの発症事例の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Hongo que se transmite de gatos a humanos alerta a especialistas: así se contagia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fungus transmitted from cats to humans warns experts: this is how it spreads.
article.articleSummary: Sporothrix brasiliensis, a fungus affecting cats, is causing a cutaneous esporotricosis outbreak in southern Uruguay, around Maldonado and Rocha. Originating in Brazil, authorities warned in late February about the spread, with Argentina also reporting rising cases, signaling a Southern Cone shift in surveillance. The fungus thrives in tropical/subtropical climates and can be transmitted to humans via contact with infected felines, leading to esporotricosis that penetrates the skin and subcutaneous tissue; rare complications include meningitis, arthritis, or respiratory infections. In affected South American regions, Brazil has documented more than 11,000 human cases in the past decade. Diagnosis uses microscopy, histopathology, or culture, and treatment is straightforward and effective. Primary symptoms after feline contact are skin eruptions or red patches. Transmission can also occur from other mammals or contaminated materials/vegetation, with outbreaks worldwide linked to wood, mining materials, or floods.

triage.headline_ja: 猫から人間に感染する真菌が専門家に警告：こうして感染する
triage.triage_reason: スポロトリコーシスの南米多国での集団発生。ブラジルで過去10年間に11,000人以上の人的症例、ウルグアイで新規集団発生、アルゼンチンでも増加報告。人獣共通感染症で複数国への拡大リスクを示唆。
triage.notes: 発生地はウルグアイのロチャ県およびマルドナード周辺で、ブラジル原産のSporothrix brasiliensisが原因。動物（特に猫）から人への感染経路が確認されており、人獣共通感染症。既にブラジル（11,000+人）、ウルグアイ（新規集団発生）、アルゼンチン（増加）の3国で報告。亜熱帯地域での流行傾向を示す。治療は有効だが、稀に髄膜炎や呼吸器感染など重篤な合併症のリスクあり。

article.articleHeadline: Campak-Rubella Menyebar di Kabupaten Cirebon, 75 Kasus Terdeteksi di 60 Puskesmas, Losari Tertinggi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles-Rubella Spreading in Cirebon Regency, 75 Cases Detected in 60 Community Health Centers, Losari Highest.
article.articleSummary: Between 2025 and early 2026, measles and rubella circulated in Cirebon Regency, Indonesia. Health authorities recorded 75 confirmed cases in 60 puskesmas during 2025—69 measles and 6 rubella—across nearly all subdistricts, with Losari Puskesmas reporting the highest case load. Of 521 suspected samples tested, 75 were confirmed. In early 2026, up to week 8, 148 suspected cases yielded 7 confirmed infections: 6 measles and 1 rubella. Measles predominated, with Astanajapura Puskesmas reporting two confirmed in early 2026; other confirmations were in Cibogo, Kamarang, Karangsari, and Pamengkang; rubella was detected in Kepuh. The reports were from Dinas Kesehatan Kabupaten Cirebon, as of March 15, 2026 (current date).

triage.triage_reason: 麻疹と風疹の複合流行がインドネシア・シレボン県で複数地区にわたり継続中（2025年～2026年初頭）で、IHR基準の「異常性」「国際拡大リスク」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準の「異常/予想外」「流行しやすさ」「長期曝露」「管理可能性」に複数該当。
triage.notes: 麻疹69症例、風疹6症例（2025年）、2026年初頭にさらに7確定症例（麻疹6、風疹1）が検出。複数の行政区画（Jawa Barat、Banten、Daerah Istimewa Yogyakarta、Jakarta）にまたがる広域流行。ワクチン接種率低下や予防接種キャンペーン不足の可能性がある。感染症の国際的拡大リスク（東南アジア地域）と地域的蔓延が併存。
